scenario: Cross-type interval equality per LINT.5.4 — `Interval<Time> == Interval<Int>` is a compile error. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck`'s `adjacent_mismatches`, whose interval arm compares the two element families and refuses with DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
schema Mix scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    t_start: Time mutable
    t_end: Time mutable
    i_start: Int mutable
    i_end: Int mutable

rule r:
    Mix m where (m.t_start..m.t_end) == (m.i_start..m.i_end)
->
    log info "x"
